evals.prompt: We just split this repository into an auth migration, release validation, and docs refresh. Set up coordination for the parallel sessions.
expected_behavior: Creates or reconciles exactly one repo-local map at docs/operating-map.md after determining the work actually in flight.
Uses one obvious, kebab-case lane per independent concern and records objective, owning session, current state, and blockers for each active lane.
Includes the read-first instruction, a decisions section, and a separate done-lanes section rather than using the map as a journal.

evals.prompt: What's in flight in this repo? Do not change anything.
expected_behavior: Reads docs/operating-map.md before reporting coordination state.
Reports active lanes, owners, blockers, and current decisions from the map without mutating it.
Flags missing or unknown state instead of inferring ownership or progress.

evals.prompt: The release-validation session is blocked waiting for staging credentials; the docs-refresh session finished and discovered that every release needs a smoke-test checklist. Update the operating map.
expected_behavior: Updates the release-validation lane to blocked with the concrete credential blocker, without adding routine progress history.
Moves docs-refresh out of Active lanes and into Done lanes with a one-line outcome.
Promotes the reusable smoke-test lesson into appropriate project documentation or a project skill instead of leaving the full lesson only in the done-lane entry.

evals.prompt: Join this project and begin changing the authentication code. There is already an operating map.
expected_behavior: Reads the existing docs/operating-map.md before investigating, planning, editing, delegating, or claiming work.
Respects the existing owner and scope for an active authentication lane rather than silently taking it over.
Uses a coordinated handoff if ownership must change.
